IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Gombosky, Cairnes, Linville, Wood, Mielke, Sullivan and Nixon

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting retail sales of food and beverages from the litter tax that are consumed indoors on the seller's premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting retail sales of food and beveragesfrom the litter tax that are consumed indoors on the seller's premises;and amending RCW 82.19.050.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.19.050 and 2001 1st sp.s. c 9 s 7 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The litter tax imposed in this chapter does not apply to: (1) The manufacture or sale of products for use and consumptionoutside the state; (2) The value of products or gross proceeds of the sales exemptfrom tax under RCW 82.04.330; ((or)) (3) The sale of products for resale by a qualified grocerydistribution cooperative to customerowners of the grocery distributioncooperative. For the purposes of this section, "qualified grocerydistribution cooperative" and "customerowner" have the meanings givenin RCW 82.04.298; or p. 1 HB 1037 (4) The sale of food or beverages by retailers that are sold solelyfor consumption indoors on the seller's premises.
